an3.85:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an3.85:2.2: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante sekho hotī ti?
an3.85:2.3: Sikkhatī ti kho bhikkhu tasmā sekho ti vuccati.
an3.85:2.5: Adhisīlam pi sikkhati adhicittam pi sikkhati adhipaññam pi sikkhatī
an3.85:2.6: ti, so kho bhikkhu tasmā sekho ti vuccatī ti.
